items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: Morgan walking up, Morgan gripping like that. Morgan said, man, right back on us, right there.

ctx.x: Don't you know about them, them soldiers can't walk? They walk too fast.

Man, I was sure glad we got up the street up in the Kinner, or them up there, by the horse canal. Now, I'm glad. And then, I was so glad, and tell you all the time we spit, man, look like there's cotton coming out to us. It was so hot, we was thirsty, there's no way they could get no water, that's a stone white ball, and we couldn't stop, you understand? Well, we got out there, had a fair, some kind of fair, just giving to get some engines up there, you understand? I mean, they're giving them. What do you mean,…
